articles.title: Trump Media’s Q1 loss widens to $406 million on bitcoin, CRO markdowns
articles.snippet: The loss was primarily driven by $244 million in unrealized losses on cryptocurrency holdings and an additional $108.2 million investment loss.

articles.title: Trump Media posts $406M quarterly loss as crypto bets turn sour
articles.snippet: Trump Media’s $405.9 million net loss was driven mostly by unrealized losses on Bitcoin bought at last summer’s peak and Cronos tokens acquired through a Crypto.com deal.

articles.title: Trump Admin Launches Pentagon UFO Website With Declassified Files
articles.snippet: The new website follows years of hearings, investigations, and pressure for greater UAP transparency.

articles.title: Trump Sons Haven't Abandoned World Liberty Financial, Crypto Firm Insists
articles.snippet: World Liberty co-founder Zach Witkoff also said Thursday that the crypto firm is “in the final stages” of receiving bank charter approval from the Trump administration.

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Shares Fall After $82 Million Q1 Loss
articles.snippet: Shares in Eric Trump's mining firm American Bitcoin have fallen more than 9% after reporting a quarterly loss of nearly $82 million.
